Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.query

Class Cursor

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.query.Cursor
public final class Cursor extends Object
Marks a position in a cursor-paginated result: the values of the order columns of one row, and whether the page wanted lies after it or before it; Laravel's Illuminate\Pagination\Cursor.

A cursor travels to a client and back as the text encode() returns, which decode(String) reads. Supported values are null, String, Long, BigDecimal, Double, Boolean, Instant, LocalDateTime, OffsetDateTime, UUID, LocalDate and LocalTime. An Integer, Short or Byte is kept as a Long, a Float as a Double, a Timestamp as an Instant, a Date as a LocalDate and a Time as a LocalTime.

The token is not signed or encrypted: a client can read it and forge another one. A forged token can only move the page position, since every value is bound as a parameter and the column names must match the query's own order columns; never put a value in a cursor that the client may not see.

Immutable and safe to share between threads.

      public Cursor(Map<String,?> parameters, boolean pointsToNextItems)
      Creates a cursor.
      Parameters:
      parameters - the order column values by column name, never null, at least one; copied, values as listed in the class description
      pointsToNextItems - true for the page after the row, false for the page before it
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if parameters or a name is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters is empty or a value has an unsupported type
